verdict.rationale: Windmill's docs say scripts and flows can be triggered by webhooks and HTTP routes, and that flows expose webhook endpoints, including version-pinned ones that target a specific flow version. That covers the core of receiving external HTTP requests to start a workflow run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the request payload is passed as run arguments, detail on custom URL paths (HTTP routes are only listed by name), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
